nodes.label: Cook-Chill Production Algorithm
nodes.description: 7-step production: Receiving/Storage (Zone 1) -> Prep/Cutting (Zone 2) -> Thermal Processing (Zone 3) -> Shock Cooling (Zone 4) -> Vacuum Sealing (Zone 4) -> Dispatch to L2 -> Reheat in Merrychef at L2. Central Kitchen model, NOT cook-to-order.

nodes.label: Zone 1: Logistics & Storage
nodes.description: Receiving area with Central Pantry (L1-SHELF-200-54), Logistics Hub (L1-SHELF-200-55), Main Cold Storage 1200L fridge (L1-SPM-FRG-200-25).

nodes.label: Zone 2: Cold Prep
nodes.description: Washing, peeling, cutting area. Double sink + UV water filter (CRITICAL for Phuket water safety), prep workstation, veg slicer, bowl cutter (8L for hummus/pesto), dough mixer (10kg spiral).

nodes.label: Zone 3: Hot Production
nodes.description: Thermal processing under extraction hood. Gas Range 4-Burner (workhorse), Lava Grill (volcanic rocks for BBQ flavor), Convection Oven (3 levels for roasting/baking).

nodes.label: Zone 4: Cook-Chill Hub
nodes.description: Heart of technology. Blast Chiller (CRITICAL BOTTLENECK — +90C to +3C in <90min), Chamber Vacuum Sealer (99.9% air removal, 7-10 day shelf life), Assembly Station (The Pass).

nodes.label: Blast Chiller (L1-BL-FRZ-790-66)
nodes.description: CRITICAL BOTTLENECK. 'The Time Machine'. Hot tray +90C -> immediately in -> +3C in <90 minutes. If full, no new hot cooking batch can start. Foundation of food safety.

nodes.label: Vacuum Sealer (L1-VAC-500-67)
nodes.description: Chamber vacuum sealer. Removes 99.9% of air. Result: 7-10 day shelf life, no oxidation, no taste degradation.

nodes.label: L1 Kitchen
nodes.description: Central kitchen + mini-store. 25-30 m2, 2 floors (balcony with mountain view). Rawai, Phuket. Rent 18,000 THB/month (paid 1 year). Production-only model, batches 07:00-10:00.

nodes.label: L2 Sales Point (Tops Daily)
nodes.description: 32 m2 sales point at high-traffic location ~1km from L1. Rent 20,000 THB/month (6 months). Two 1.5m salad bars (56 trays), assembly <2 min, Merrychef reheat, open fridge for take-away.

nodes.label: Shishka Brand Identity
nodes.description: Shishka Eat Healthy. Slogan: 'Fresh as creation, alive like the soul'. Vision: global healthy fast-food leader with franchise potential. USP: customizable salad bars + nutrient calculations + AI recommendations + superfoods. Functional Gastronomy concept.

nodes.label: Functional Gastronomy
nodes.description: Core concept at intersection of Bio-Hacking (nutrient-dense, superfoods, Lion's Mane, turmeric), Comfort (tastes great, not clinical), and Green Insurance (daily health investment).

nodes.label: Cook-Chill Technology
nodes.description: Industrial food safety via L1 factory -> L2 assembly model. Key differentiator enabling consistency, shelf life, and food safety without preservatives.

nodes.label: Culinary Booster System (CBS)
nodes.description: Flavor LEGO framework. Pre-made flavor concentrates on 3 axes: Foundation (acid/fat/salt), Accents (aroma/umami), Finish (texture/heat/sweet). Core products: Green Gold Oil, Shishka Dust, Ancient Crunch. Ensures consistency, reduces TTR by 30-45s, zero-waste.

nodes.label: Build-Your-Own Salad Bar
nodes.description: 56 gastro-containers across 2 salad bars. Algorithm Bowl approach: Fiber Base + Sustain-Pro + Bio-Active + Crunch. Bar 1: bases and proteins (28 slots). Bar 2: superfoods, ferments, crunch, sauces (28 slots).

nodes.label: Zero-Waste Production
nodes.description: Salmon trimmings -> tartare, bones -> broth, herb stems/lemon rinds/vegetable peels -> CBS Boosters. Higher margin on waste products than original ingredients.

nodes.label: Food Cost Target <= 30%
nodes.description: Core financial KPI. Achieved through zero-waste, standardized bricks, CBS converting low-cost raw materials into high-perceived-value items.

nodes.label: Time to Receipt (TTR) < 2 min
nodes.description: Operational KPI for L2 service speed. Assembly time target at sales point.

nodes.label: Kitchen Philosophy Three Pillars
nodes.description: Non-negotiable: (1) Functional food — every dish has functional component (adaptogens, enzymes, superfoods), (2) Clean label — all sauces in-house, no industrial ingredients, (3) Zero waste — trim into fermented bases/broths/probiotic shots.

nodes.label: Red Lines (Never)
nodes.description: Banned ingredients: refined sugar, trans fats, refined seed oils (soy/canola/sunflower/corn), artificial colorants/preservatives, MSG. Banned techniques: deep frying, prolonged high-heat. Banned styles: heavy comfort food, mayo-based sauces.

nodes.label: Quality Equation
nodes.description: Flavor Score + Functional Value + FC% Compliance = Success. Four criteria: flavor balance (5 tastes + umami), nutrient density, plating aesthetic, reproducibility. All four required.

nodes.label: Lego Modularity Protocol
nodes.description: Menu built from swappable modules: Bases (grains/greens), Proteins (sous-vide), Toppings (fermented veg, activated nuts), Dressings (functional sauces). Seasonal changes = swap 1-2 modules, no staff retraining.

nodes.label: Seasonality 80/20 Rule
nodes.description: 80% stable core menu (year-round, anchors LTV customers) + 20% seasonal rotations (novelty, local-calendar produce). Phuket wet/dry season calendar for fruits and greens.

nodes.label: Guest Persona: Conscious Optimizer
nodes.description: Expats and tourists in Rawai (digital nomads, athletes, yogis). Buying Green Insurance, not food. Want: functionality (energy without sugar crash), trust (clean label, transparency), time saved (grab-and-go speed at chef quality).

nodes.label: Bible Index (Knowledge Map)
nodes.description: Routing manifest for project bible. 10 canonical files covering identity, kitchen philosophy, menu concept, menu items, operations, locations, equipment, benchmarks, targets, sources. Field notes protocol for knowledge updates.

nodes.label: Competitor Benchmarks
nodes.description: 13 competitors analyzed (Salata, Sweetgreen, Just Salad, Chopt, etc.). Key insights: salad bar customization dominant trend, AI/tech integration validated, superfoods+fermentation under-exploited, Arab-Russian fusion has NO direct competitor in SE Asia.

nodes.label: External Sources & Resources
nodes.description: Google Drive as primary shared storage (financial plan, expenses, equipment, menu, photos). Internal docs: bible/, constitution/, domain/, business/domains/. Culinary reference books listed.

nodes.label: Label Printer Brief
nodes.description: Spec for thermal label printer (ZPL, Wi-Fi, 50x30mm labels). Zebra ZD421 recommended. Budget up to 15,000 THB. For printing product name, barcode, weight, production/expiry dates on sealed containers. 20-50 labels/day.

nodes.label: CEO Operations Guide
nodes.description: How CEO manages work via Claude (Cowork + Code). 4 epics defined: Kitchen Production System, Barcode & Batch Tracking, Finance & Security, UX & Operations. Daily workflow: morning triage (15 min), domain-routed work, evening status update.

nodes.label: Dispatch Rules (Task Router)
nodes.description: 8 domains (kitchen, procurement, finance, marketing, ops, sales, strategy, tech) with keyword trigger matrix and cascade routing. COO autonomous lane for low-risk tasks. Orchestrator autonomy (2026-04-23) with whitelist/blacklist. Human task conventions with executor_type and assigned_to.

nodes.label: COO Split: Strategy + Tech-Lead
nodes.description: Monolithic COO split into Strategic COO (/strategy) and Technical Tech-Lead (/techlead). /coo is auto-router that classifies messages by keywords. Tie-breaker goes to Strategic COO (idea loss worse than misclassification).

nodes.label: Operations & People Domain
nodes.description: Scope: staff scheduling, shift management, SOPs, training, equipment maintenance, hygiene protocols. Key systems: Admin Panel (Schedule/Kitchen/Equipment), Supabase (staff, shifts, equipment tables). Thai FDA compliance.

nodes.label: Breakfasts (AM / Circadian Nutrition)
nodes.description: Healthy English variants (Shishka Classic, Nordic Morning, Levantine Start), Functional Porridges (Buckwheat Umami Bomb with Lion's Mane, Tropical Oatmeal, Asian Rice Porridge). Combi-oven + lava grill.

nodes.label: Sandwiches, Rolls, Burgers, Manakish
nodes.description: Grab & Go base. Rice paper rolls (Shrimp & Mango, Vegan Rainbow), Rice-Nori Bun burgers (Salmon Tartare, Chicken Teriyaki), Sourdough toasts, Manakish (Za'atar, Lahmacun). Assembled at L2, reheated 60s.

nodes.label: Soups
nodes.description: Bio-Active Borscht, Functional Fungi mushroom cream, Asian Pumpkin Fusion, Healthy Chicken Ramen (collagen broth). Cooked at L1 in kettles, vacuum-sealed, delivered to L2 bain-maries.

nodes.label: Main Courses (Medical-Grade Nutrition)
nodes.description: Lava-Grilled Chicken & Quinoa, Salmon Tsar Bowl, Shrimp & Avocado Cauliflower Rice, Vegan Power Meatball. 90% cooked rule at L1, blast chilled, vacuum sealed, regenerated at L2 in Merrychef 60s.

nodes.label: Why Central Kitchen Model
nodes.description: L1 operates as a factory, not a restaurant. Cook-chill enables: food safety without preservatives (5-7 day shelf life), consistency (standardized bricks), speed at L2 (<2 min assembly), zero cross-contamination at sales point.

nodes.label: Why CBS Exists
nodes.description: CBS converts low-cost raw materials (seeds, tomato paste, local herbs) into high-perceived-value additives. 90% of flavor pre-locked in booster, L2 staff only assemble. Enables consistency without skilled labor at service point, reduces FC%, uses waste (lemon rinds, herb stems).

nodes.label: Why Single SSoT for Secrets
nodes.description: Prevents secret sprawl across multiple .env files. Private single-user repo uses gitignored *.local files. Keychain for truly sensitive secrets (SERVICE_ROLE_KEY). Will switch to secret-manager when team grows.

nodes.label: Hub-Spoke Financial Architecture
nodes.description: expense_ledger as Hub with purchase_logs, capex_transactions, opex_items as Spokes. Enables atomic multi-table writes via fn_approve_receipt and unified financial querying.

nodes.label: Dumb POS Strategy
nodes.description: SYRVE reduced to thin fiscal gateway (receipts + payments + order entry). All kitchen intelligence, inventory, analytics, HR in Shishka OS. Zero POS add-on licensing. Multi-location cost = base POS + iPad + Internet.

nodes.label: Agent for Reasoning, Pipeline for Execution
nodes.description: Structured extraction (receipt parsing) should be a deterministic pipeline with single API call, not an 8-10 turn agent loop. Reduces cost from $1.5-3.0 to $0.01-0.10 per receipt.
nodes.norm_label: agent for reasoning, pipeline for execution

nodes.label: MemPalace Storage Outside GDrive
nodes.description: SQLite + ChromaDB use lock-files and multi-file transactions. GDrive sync corrupts them within days. Live DB must be at ~/.mempalace/ (FileVault), backups age-encrypted before GDrive.

nodes.label: MC as State (No State Files)
nodes.description: COO state reconstructed from Mission Control at session start, not stored in .md files. Single source of truth, searchable in Postgres, decay-visible via timestamps.

nodes.label: Autonomous Lane for Low-Risk Tasks
nodes.description: Low-risk reversible work (docs/cleanup/refactor/bug-fix) handed directly COO→Code without CEO mediation. Reduces latency without reducing safety. Kill switch via tag.

nodes.label: MVP-First Planning Protocol
nodes.description: For any new initiative exceeding 1 sprint: identify smallest demonstrable slice first, cut aggressively, defer remainder to explicit v2 MC task. Nothing lost, just deferred.

nodes.label: COO Agent
nodes.description: Coordination center of Shishka OS. Idea capture, cross-agent sync, priority discipline, meta-advisory, translation gateway. Does not write code.

nodes.label: Strategy Orchestrator Agent

nodes.label: Dispatcher Agent
nodes.description: Unified entry point for all agents. Classifies CEO intent by keywords and routes to /chef, /finance, /code, /coo. Shows MC summary at session start.

nodes.label: Mission Control (MC)

nodes.summary: HC-1: Status auto-generated post-commit (never manual). HC-2: Domain boundaries enforced in code (ESLint + RLS). HC-3: Tests before logic (AI-TDD gate). Chosen to prevent manual sync drift, domain violations, and untested code

nodes.label: Why Split COO into Two Agents
nodes.summary: Running Log retired (MemPalace replaced it), attention overload measured (6 sessions without inbox triage), compound-engineering surface too wide for one agent. CEO directive to separate strategic vs technical concerns
nodes.norm_label: why split coo into two agents

nodes.label: Why Three Orthogonal Memory Layers
nodes.summary: Each layer answers different questions: L1 MemPalace for decisions/preferences, L2+L3 Graphify for code/docs/knowledge. CEO was human bus re-explaining context. LightRAG decommissioned because Graphify covers same corpus plus code with 93.5x token reduction

nodes.label: Why Evolve COO to Proactive Orchestrator
nodes.summary: CEO carries all decomposition/scoping/coordination mentally. No human-domain agent dispatch. No process retrospective loop. MC inbox decay measurable (stale tasks, spec_file TBD violations). Orchestrator fills these gaps
nodes.norm_label: why evolve coo to proactive orchestrator

nodes.label: Why Thin CLAUDE.md (~40 lines)
nodes.summary: 70% of sessions pay full token tax for routing context they don't need. Auto-routing keyword tables cost ~800 tokens and duplicate model's inherent domain inference. Boris Cherny pattern: ~50 lines of principles, zero routing tables

nodes.label: RULE-PLAN-BEFORE-BUILD
nodes.summary: For any task requiring 3+ steps: write plan first, get confirmation, then build. Simple fixes exempt

nodes.label: RULE-VERIFY-BEFORE-DONE
nodes.summary: Never mark task done without proof: build passes, lint passes, at least one verification method (tests/UI/diff/grep). Includes elegance pause

nodes.label: RULE-MINIMAL-CORRECT-CHANGE
nodes.summary: Every change must be minimal (scope files only), root-cause (fix cause not symptom), and simple (direct over abstract, abstract only at 3+ repetitions)

nodes.label: RULE-MIGRATION-TRACKING
nodes.summary: Every migration file must end with self-register INSERT into migration_log. Run check_migrations() before and after applying
